acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

computeModelId(string,string).details: Convenience helper — callers can compute this off-chain identically via         keccak256(abi.encodePacked(name, version)).

params._halo2Verifier: Address of the deployed EZKL Halo2Verifier contract.
params._initialOwner: Address that will own this contract (use a multisig in prod).

getAttestation(bytes32).details: Returns zero-value struct if outputHash has not been verified.

getModel(bytes32).details: Reverts if the model has not been registered.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

registerModel(bytes32,string,bytes32).details: Reverts if modelId has already been registered or if ipfsCid is empty.

params.inputShapeHash: keccak256 of the ABI-encoded input shape array.                       Lets callers verify input compatibility without storing                       the full shape on-chain.
params.ipfsCid: Full IPFS CID string of the model artifact (e.g. "Qm...").                       Emitted in ModelRegistered for off-chain indexers.
params.modelId: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(name, version)).                       Computed off-chain by the gateway; must be globally unique.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setSettler(address,bool).details: Emits SettlerUpdated. Use a multisig as owner in production.

params.inputHash: keccak256 of the raw inference input (privacy-preserving).
params.instances: Public inputs/outputs of the circuit (model outputs as field elements).
params.modelId: keccak256 of the ONNX model content hash registered off-chain.
params.outputHash: keccak256 of the claimed inference output. Stored as the attestation key.
params.proof: Raw proof bytes from the EZKL prover.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

upgradeVerifier(address).details: Does NOT invalidate existing attestations — they were valid under         the old verifier and remain so. New submissions use the new verifier.

computeModelId(string,string).notice: Derive the modelId key used throughout this contract.

getAttestation(bytes32).notice: Returns the full attestation record for a verified output hash.

getModel(bytes32).notice: Returns the registration record for a model.

isRegisteredModel(bytes32).notice: modelId → registered flag. Separate for cheap O(1) lookups.

isSettler(address).notice: Settler whitelist. Only settlers may call submitProof().

isVerified(bytes32).notice: outputHash → verified flag. Separate for cheap O(1) lookups.

pause().notice: Pause proof submissions. Existing attestations remain readable.

registerModel(bytes32,string,bytes32).notice: Register a model on-chain after it has been pinned to IPFS.         Must be called by the owner before any jobs can be settled for         this model. Registration is permanent — no update or delete path.

setSettler(address,bool).notice: Approve or revoke a settler address.

submitProof(bytes,uint256[],bytes32,byte.notice: Submit a ZK proof for an inference result.         Reverts if the proof is invalid or the output has already been attested.

upgradeVerifier(address).notice: Replace the underlying Halo2 circuit verifier.         Required when a new model version produces a new circuit/vk.
